json_schema.$comment: Review output contract, used for both scoped slice reviews and the readiness round. The schema enforces SHAPE; only the prompt's proof-of-work bar makes `evidence` a pasted command output rather than a sentence. Read the evidence.

scope.description: What was reviewed, restated: branch, diff spec, and the concern this reviewer was assigned. A restatement that drifts means the prompt did not arrive.

coverage.description: Proof of work, per category. Required even when a category yields no findings — a 'none found' without proof of work is not a review.

ranges_read.description: Exact file:line ranges read for this category.

probe_command.description: A command you personally ran, designed so it would FAIL if the defect existed.

probe_output.description: The verbatim output of that command. Not a description of it.

id.description: Stable within this review, e.g. F1.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state, and the wrong behavior they produce.

evidence.description: Pasted output of a command you ran that demonstrates it. If you could not demonstrate it, say so here explicitly.

unverified_fix_verdicts.description: One entry per fix commit listed in the brief's unverified-fixes table. Omitting one is itself a finding.

out_of_scope_observations.description: Real defects outside your fence. Report them; do not fix them.

not_verified.description: What you could not check, and why. A gap you name is useful; a gap you paper over will be found at the gate.
